classification: low-weight adjunct screening of R391 statistical-pass factors not in R499; train+validation selection; test/recent confirmation; no promotion unless all gates pass
known_limits: Adjunct weights are a small pre-registered grid, not an exhaustive optimizer.
Candidates were already statistically screened and are not independent discoveries.
The test/recent windows have been observed before.
Current HS300 membership and industry classification retain survivorship bias.
5x cost is warning-only and never a hard rejection.
No leverage and no production activation.
